simple.meaning: מַמְלָכָה (mamlâkâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “dominion , i.e. (abstractly) the estate ( rule ) or (concretely) the country ( realm ).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 117 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 11 more, beginning at Genesis 10:10. Its contexts include family line, kingship, priesthood, city, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַמְלָכָה (H4467).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מַמְלָכָה (mamlâkâh) / H4467 is traced through Genesis 10:10, Genesis 20:9, Exodus 19:6, Numbers 32:33 as a generated source-based concept entry.
